name: Chen Cheng's embassy to Herat
summary: The Yongle emperor sends Chen Cheng to the court of Shah Rukh, Timur's son, at Herat. He keeps a day-by-day route book and writes a survey of the eighteen countries on the way, both presented to the emperor on his return: the fullest Chinese account of Timurid Central Asia.

stops.note: The end of the Great Wall at Jiayu Pass.
At the court of Shah Rukh.
He presents his route book and his survey to the emperor.

informs.note: Chen Cheng at Shah Rukh's court
